protectedRevelations: Proposed metrics, SmoothingBench and SmoothTrace implementation

scenes.title: Nothing false, something missing
scenes.viewerPurpose: Make the distinctive idea or tension understandable on first hearing. Introduce the book-specific proposal clearly and leave its fuller explanation for reading.
scenes.composition: A factual-looking summary omits the person who loses clinic access
addOrChange: Keep the missing relation recoverable beside the unchanged facts.

cues.narration: The Smoothing names a troubling possibility: AI can keep the facts while hiding who gets hurt.
cues.visualAction: Show the true facts in the neat statement while the waiting person falls outside its account.

cues.narration: The book proposes ways to study that loss, using short examples you can judge for yourself.
cues.visualAction: A reader compares the short example with its source and restores the omitted affected person.

scenes.title: The missing consequence
scenes.viewerPurpose: Hear a hard choice becoming a reassuring success story Picture a loss fading while remaining facts look true
scenes.composition: A clinic relocation leaves the same visitor at an unusable stop
addOrChange: Remove fast transport choreography and retain one before-and-after relation.

cues.narration: A difficult choice can become a tidy account of improvement.
cues.visualAction: The tidy improvement announcement appears over the new clinic.

cues.narration: Someone’s loss or a difficult doubt slips out, while the remaining facts still look familiar.
cues.visualAction: The visitor waits as the shorter message loses the access detail.

scenes.title: A smooth account
scenes.viewerPurpose: Understand the book proposes studying this loss Want to feel how small word changes redirect attention
scenes.composition: A reviewer compares two short accounts of the same change
addOrChange: Keep one missing consequence rather than an overall quality score.

cues.narration: The book asks how to study what gets lost when an AI makes a story smoother.
cues.visualAction: Reconnect the omitted transport detail to the visitor.

cues.narration: Short examples let you feel how a few changed words can move your attention.
cues.visualAction: Switch wording while the actual waiting situation stays unchanged.

scenes.title: Look again at the source
scenes.viewerPurpose: Connect the question to writing and reading summaries Ask what readability made harder to notice
scenes.composition: A reader recovers the source detail beside the affected person
addOrChange: Remove duplicate information panels and end on the human consequence.

cues.narration: For anyone who writes, edits, or relies on summaries, the question is immediately practical.
cues.visualAction: Check the short statement against its fuller source.

cues.narration: What did the elegant version make easier to read, and harder to see?
cues.visualAction: Hold the waiting person as the missing relation returns.
